subject: Evening panel roundup — bridge consolidation & capacity plan
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Acme Demo Team <sales@acme.com>; Eva Lim <eva@beta.ai>; Charles Duvall <charles@enterpriseco.com>
Cc: 
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Evening panel roundup — bridge consolidation & capacity plan

Hi team and folks at Acme/Eva/Charles —

Quick note: we have a cluster of evening demo RSVPs next week that overlap on our single APAC-evening bridge. Rather than run separate sessions, I'd like to consolidate three small prospects into a single "panel-style" demo with breakout intent, then offer a standby waitlist for anyone who can't make that slot.

Proposed outline (attached):
- 40m joint presentation (capabilities + cost controls)
- 20m breakout rooms by vertical (up to 3)
- 10m Q&A + next-step scheduling

Operational asks: Ben/Neha — can you confirm whether we can open an additional bridge (temporary) or if we should plan a host-swap to another timezone engineer? Jordan — can you draft an AM/PM capacity map so we know how many concurrent breakout rooms we can support?

Charles/Eva/Acme — would combining into a single panel work for you if we guarantee a short follow-up slot with a prioritized MUTUAL ACTION PLAN? If anyone needs a dedicated deep-dive instead, we can schedule 1:1 follow-ups.

Attachments: [attachment: evening-panel-agenda.pdf (PDF, 72KB)] and a quick MAP draft attached.

Thanks —
Mateo
Sr. Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
(attachment: MAP-EnterpriseCo.xlsx)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>

Cc: Acme Demo Team <sales@acme.com>, Eva Lim <eva@beta.ai>, Charles Duvall <charles@enterpriseco.com>
Date: Thu, 27 May 2027 16:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Evening panel roundup — bridge consolidation & capacity plan

Mateo — thanks for the plan. Quick ops update: we can spin up a second bridge for the evening slot but it requires a one-hour lead to provision and a host with elevated bridge rights. If Neha is available to host the second bridge we can do simultaneous breakout rooms (2 parallel breakouts + main room) without degrading RTP.

Jordan — if you can confirm expected attendance per prospect (approx. headcount), we can size the breakout rooms. I recommend we cap total concurrent participants at 120 to stay under our SLOs.

Also adding a tiny process note: please have the MAP worksheet pre-filled with requested topics per account so the breakouts have handoffs. I attached a stubbed "bridge-pass" we can use to give external attendees dial-in specifics.

Cheers,
Ben
Head of Demo Ops | Redwood Inference
(attachment: bridge-pass-stub.txt)

Thanks Mateo — panel sounds efficient. A couple of constraints from our side:
- A few folks in Finance can't attend after 8pm ET (we're US based) and prefer a 4pm ET slot.
- We must keep the solution demo focused on private deployment options and audit logs (SOC2).

If you can offer either a 4pm ET alternative or guarantee a dedicated 30m 1:1 after the panel for Finance, we'll join the panel. Also requesting the MAP pre-fill (we added redlines in the shared doc).

Charles
Senior Procurement Manager | EnterpriseCo

Thanks for the quick responses — finalizing here so ops can action: 

1) Primary panel: Thu June 3, 2027 — 7:00pm PT / 10:00pm ET (main + 2 breakouts).
2) Alternate 1: Thu June 3, 2027 — 4:00pm PT / 7:00pm ET (reserved for EnterpriseCo finance team). We will run a shortened main (30m) + dedicated 30m 1:1 for EnterpriseCo after the panel.

4) Waitlist: external attendees who can't make either slot will be offered a 1:1 within 72 hours — MAPs will be prioritized by deal stage.
